reef.text:
The sound is not a wave. It is a long grinding, the kind that travels up through the deck and into your teeth. The boat turns broadside. Somebody is shouting a name that is not yours. {cargo} shifts once, all together, and then the water comes over the side.

There is a light on the shore. It is a long way off.

choices.text: Hold to the cargo and shout for help.
Swim for the light and let the load go.

provenance.notes: A grave road outcome. In this slice it returns the traveller; it is not a permanent-death screen.
